description: Key financials from a company's 10-K/10-Q XBRL data: revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, long-term debt and shares outstanding. Each metric has the latest annual value, prior annual value, YoY growth % and the latest reported period, plus net margin, gross margin and debt-to-equity. Values in USD as reported.

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL", "BRK.B") or SEC CIK number (e.g. "320193").

name: get_company_snapshot
title: Company financial snapshot (XBRL)
